coverage_note: Report couples leaf transcriptomics and metabolomics on senescence. One qualifying unit: the controlled nitrogen pot intervention (N0/CK vs N150/T150) whose omics and physiology are outcomes. Enrichment/integration, differential expression/abundance, multivariate clustering, speculative metabolite modulation, and cited external interventions are recorded as non-qualifying boundaries.

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Cross-omics annotation/enrichment and pathway direction; no identifying variation of its own, the assignment lies in the nitrogen intervention.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Integrated transcriptome-metabolome KEGG analysis identifying phenylpropanoid (ko00940) and flavonoid (ko00941) biosynthesis pathways

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Speculative future intervention; no perturbation was performed and no current-report empirical result exists for modulating these metabolites.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Proposed modulation of chlorogenic acid and naringenin chalcone levels to delay premature senescence

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: External interventions described in the introduction; not current-report empirical results.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Cited external findings that exogenous ABA, ethylene and SA regulate senescence-associated genes

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Same nitrogen controlled intervention source; the additional N225 dose is a child contrast within the qualifying analysis.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Growth comparison across three nitrogen levels (N0, N150, N225)

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential expression readout under the nitrogen intervention; a child contrast/fragment of the qualifying pot experiment, not a distinct design.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Differential gene expression analysis (4350 DEGs) between T150 and CK lower leaves

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Unsupervised/discriminant classification distinguishing groups; no identifying variation, association/classification only.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: PCA and OPLS-DA multivariate discrimination of T150 versus CK metabolomes

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential abundance readout under the same nitrogen intervention; a child contrast, not a separate design unit.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Differential metabolite screening (135 DEMs) between T150 and CK lower leaves

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: External genetic-perturbation study cited in the discussion; no current-report result.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Cited external study: overexpression of PAL/C4H/4CL/HCT/HQT/C3H increases cellular chlorogenic acid

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Controlled nitrogen-application pot experiment comparing optimal-nitrogen (N150/T150, normal) versus no-nitrogen (N0/CK, premature senescence) red raspberry seedlings with transcriptome and metabolome readouts
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Potted tissue-cultured double-season red raspberry 'Polka' seedlings, focusing on lower functional leaves
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Single controlled nitrogen intervention; all three dose levels, tissue positions and the transcriptome/metabolome readouts are child contrasts under one intervention source and one biological system. qRT-PCR treated as supportive same-experiment validation of the transcriptomic readout.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: N0 no-nitrogen control (CK) contrasted with N150 optimal-nitrogen treatment (T150)
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Nitrogen fertilization level (optimal N150 vs no-nitrogen N0)
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Investigator-assigned nitrogen application rates (0, 0.10, 0.15 g N/kg dry soil) to potted seedlings in a controlled pot experiment
outcome_constructs: membrane lipid peroxidation (MDA, O2-) and antioxidant enzyme activities
photosynthetic pigment, soluble protein/sugar and starch contents
premature leaf senescence and shoot growth phenotype
